label_source.ood160: human-labelled Egocentric-10K sample (138 good / 22 bad, one labeller)

protocol.band_rule: accept if score>=0.5+w; reject if score<=0.5-w; else review
protocol.ci: factory-grouped bootstrap 2000x of the 47 factories (all windows of a sampled factory enter together)
protocol.gate_rule: decide top-`coverage` fraction by cost-margin |p-0.5| (cost 1:1); review the rest; review% on 1546 = 1-coverage exactly
protocol.ood_error: balanced accuracy over DECIDED windows of the 160 human-labelled OOD set (138 good / 22 bad, 47 factories); PRE-REGISTERED TEST, evaluation only, nothing fit on it
protocol.rankavg: 0.5*(avg-rank(p_eg2)+avg-rank(p_pixel)) scaled to [0,1] within each dataset; no new inference

reproduction.note: stored ood_scores verdicts use band [0.4,0.6]; the deployed E8 profile band is [0.25,0.75] (75.5% review). Both reproduced row-for-row.

title: Review-vs-OOD-error frontier on the 160-window pre-registered OOD test
